content.json:
# Well-Architected Framework
A workload's gaps against the five pillars of the Azure Well-Architected Framework: Reliability, Security, Cost Optimization, Operational Excellence and Performance Efficiency. Each pillar combines Azure Advisor's recommendations with configuration checks read from Azure Resource Graph, so no workspace is needed; picking one adds the checks only logs can answer. The Assessment tab records the answers to the Well-Architected checklist and scores each pillar.

parameters.name: Subscription
parameters.label: Subscriptions
parameters.query:
summarize by subscriptionId
| project value = strcat('/subscriptions/', subscriptionId), label = subscriptionId

parameters.name: WorkloadTag
parameters.label: Workload tag
parameters.description: The tag whose value names the workload a resource belongs to. Tag names here match case.

parameters.name: Workload
parameters.label: Workload
parameters.query:
resources
| extend wl = tostring(tags['{WorkloadTag}'])
| where isnotempty(wl)
| summarize Resources = count() by wl
| project value = wl, label = strcat(wl, '  (', Resources, ' resources)')
| order by value asc
parameters.description: The workloads to review, from the values of the workload tag. All includes untagged resources.

parameters.name: Workspace
parameters.label: Log Analytics workspace
parameters.description: Optional. The workspaces the workload sends its logs to. Adds the checks only logs can answer: heartbeats, request failures, refused access, resources sending no logs, ingestion, and CPU and memory.

parameters.name: TimeRange
parameters.label: Time range
parameters.description: The period the log-based panels cover. The Resource Graph panels show the current state.

parameters.name: WorkloadIds
parameters.query:
resources
| where not('*' in ({Workload}))
| where tostring(tags['{WorkloadTag}']) in ({Workload})
| where type in~ ('microsoft.compute/virtualmachines', 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines', 'microsoft.apimanagement/service', 'microsoft.app/managedenvironments', 'microsoft.appconfiguration/configurationstores', 'microsoft.cache/redis', 'microsoft.cdn/profiles', 'microsoft.cognitiveservices/accounts', 'microsoft.containerregistry/registries', 'microsoft.containerservice/managedclusters', 'microsoft.datafactory/factories', 'microsoft.dbformysql/flexibleservers', 'microsoft.dbforpostgresql/flexibleservers', 'microsoft.documentdb/databaseaccounts', 'microsoft.eventgrid/topics', 'microsoft.eventhub/namespaces', 'microsoft.insights/components', 'microsoft.keyvault/vaults', 'microsoft.logic/workflows', 'microsoft.network/applicationgateways', 'microsoft.network/azurefirewalls', 'microsoft.network/bastionhosts', 'microsoft.network/frontdoors', 'microsoft.network/virtualnetworkgateways', 'microsoft.recoveryservices/vaults', 'microsoft.search/searchservices', 'microsoft.servicebus/namespaces', 'microsoft.signalrservice/signalr', 'microsoft.sql/servers', 'microsoft.storage/storageaccounts', 'microsoft.web/sites')
| project value = tolower(id), label = name

content.json: ### Pillars

content.query:
resources
| where type in~ ('microsoft.apimanagement/service', 'microsoft.app/managedenvironments', 'microsoft.cache/redis', 'microsoft.cdn/profiles', 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines', 'microsoft.containerservice/managedclusters', 'microsoft.dbformariadb/servers', 'microsoft.dbformysql/flexibleservers', 'microsoft.dbformysql/servers', 'microsoft.dbforpostgresql/flexibleservers', 'microsoft.dbforpostgresql/servers', 'microsoft.documentdb/databaseaccounts', 'microsoft.keyvault/vaults', 'microsoft.network/applicationgateways', 'microsoft.network/azurefirewalls', 'microsoft.network/frontdoors', 'microsoft.network/loadbalancers', 'microsoft.network/publicipaddresses', 'microsoft.network/virtualnetworkgateways', 'microsoft.recoveryservices/vaults', 'microsoft.sql/servers/databases', 'microsoft.storage/storageaccounts', 'microsoft.web/serverfarms')
| where '*' in ({Workload}) or tostring(tags['{WorkloadTag}']) in ({Workload})
| extend Findings = pack_array(
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines' and ((isnull(zones) or array_length(zones) == 0) and isempty(tostring(properties.availabilitySet.id)) and isempty(tostring(properties.virtualMachineScaleSet.id))), pack('Finding', 'VM with no availability zone, availability set or scale set', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', tostring(properties.hardwareProfile.vmSize), 'Fix', 'Run two or more instances across availability zones, or record the single point of failure as accepted'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.network/publicipaddresses' and (tostring(sku.name) =~ 'Basic'), pack('Finding', 'Basic SKU public IP (retired September 2025)', 'Severity', 'High', 'Detail', tostring(properties.ipAddress), 'Fix', 'Upgrade to a Standard SKU public IP'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.network/loadbalancers' and (tostring(sku.name) =~ 'Basic'), pack('Finding', 'Basic SKU load balancer (retired September 2025)', 'Severity', 'High', 'Detail', '', 'Fix', 'Upgrade to a Standard load balancer'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.network/applicationgateways' and (tostring(properties.sku.tier) in~ ('Standard', 'WAF')), pack('Finding', 'Application Gateway v1 (retired April 2026)', 'Severity', 'High', 'Detail', tostring(properties.sku.name), 'Fix', 'Migrate to Application Gateway v2'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.network/applicationgateways' and (tostring(properties.sku.tier) in~ ('Standard_v2', 'WAF_v2') and (isnull(zones) or array_length(zones) < 2)), pack('Finding', 'Application Gateway not spread across zones', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', tostring(properties.sku.name), 'Fix', 'Redeploy the gateway across availability zones'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.network/azurefirewalls' and ((isnull(zones) or array_length(zones) < 2)), pack('Finding', 'Azure Firewall not spread across zones', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', tostring(properties.sku.tier), 'Fix', 'Deploy the firewall across availability zones'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.network/virtualnetworkgateways' and (not(tostring(properties.sku.name) endswith 'AZ') and tostring(properties.sku.name) !~ 'ErGwScale'), pack('Finding', 'VPN or ExpressRoute gateway SKU is not zone-redundant', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', strcat(tostring(properties.gatewayType), ' ', tostring(properties.sku.name)), 'Fix', 'Move to an AZ SKU (or ErGwScale for ExpressRoute)'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.storage/storageaccounts' and (tostring(sku.name) endswith '_LRS'), pack('Finding', 'Storage account is locally redundant (LRS)', 'Severity', 'Low', 'Detail', strcat(tostring(sku.name), ' ', kind), 'Fix', 'Use ZRS, or GZRS for data that must survive the loss of a region'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.web/serverfarms' and (tolower(tostring(sku.tier)) !in ('free', 'shared', 'dynamic', 'basic', 'elasticpremium', 'flexconsumption') and toint(sku.capacity) < 2), pack('Finding', 'App Service plan runs a single instance', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', strcat(tostring(sku.name), ' x', tostring(sku.capacity)), 'Fix', 'Run at least two instances (three with zone redundancy)'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.web/serverfarms' and (tolower(tostring(sku.tier)) in ('premiumv2', 'premiumv3', 'premium0v3', 'premiummv3', 'isolatedv2') and tobool(properties.zoneRedundant) != true), pack('Finding', 'App Service plan not zone-redundant', 'Severity', 'Low', 'Detail', tostring(sku.name), 'Fix', 'Turn on zone redundancy (needs three or more instances)'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.sql/servers/databases' and (name !~ 'master' and tostring(sku.tier) !in~ ('Basic', 'Standard', 'Free', 'System') and tobool(properties.zoneRedundant) != true), pack('Finding', 'SQL database not zone-redundant', 'Severity', 'Low', 'Detail', strcat(tostring(sku.tier), ' ', tostring(sku.name)), 'Fix', 'Turn on zone redundancy'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.containerservice/managedclusters' and (tostring(properties.agentPoolProfiles) !contains '"availabilityZones":["'), pack('Finding', 'AKS node pools not spread across zones', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', tostring(properties.kubernetesVersion), 'Fix', 'Create node pools across availability zones'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.containerservice/managedclusters' and (tostring(sku.tier) =~ 'Free'), pack('Finding', 'AKS cluster on the Free tier (no uptime SLA)', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', '', 'Fix', 'Use the Standard tier for production clusters'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.keyvault/vaults' and (tobool(properties.enablePurgeProtection) != true), pack('Finding', 'Key Vault without purge protection', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', '', 'Fix', 'Turn on purge protection so a deleted key or secret can always be recovered'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.cache/redis' and (tostring(properties.sku.name) =~ 'Basic'), pack('Finding', 'Azure Cache for Redis on the Basic tier (one node, no SLA)', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', strcat(tostring(properties.sku.family), tostring(properties.sku.capacity)), 'Fix', 'Use Standard or Premium for anything beyond development'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.documentdb/databaseaccounts' and (coalesce(array_length(properties.locations), 0) < 2 and tostring(properties.locations) !contains '"isZoneRedundant":true'), pack('Finding', 'Cosmos DB account in one region with no zone redundancy', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', tostring(properties.locations[0].locationName), 'Fix', 'Turn on zone redundancy, or add a second region'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.network/frontdoors' and (true), pack('Finding', 'Front Door (classic), retiring March 2027', 'Severity', 'High', 'Detail', '', 'Fix', 'Migrate to Azure Front Door Standard or Premium'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.cdn/profiles' and (tostring(sku.name) in~ ('Standard_Verizon', 'Premium_Verizon')), pack('Finding', 'Azure CDN from Edgio (shut down January 2025)', 'Severity', 'High', 'Detail', tostring(sku.name), 'Fix', 'Move to Azure Front Door Standard or Premium'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.cdn/profiles' and (tostring(sku.name) =~ 'Standard_Microsoft'), pack('Finding', 'Azure CDN Standard from Microsoft (classic), retiring September 2027', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', tostring(sku.name), 'Fix', 'Migrate to Azure Front Door Standard or Premium'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.apimanagement/service' and (tostring(properties.platformVersion) =~ 'stv1'), pack('Finding', 'API Management on the stv1 platform (retired August 2024)', 'Severity', 'High', 'Detail', tostring(sku.name), 'Fix', 'Migrate the instance to stv2'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.apimanagement/service' and (tostring(sku.name) =~ 'Developer'), pack('Finding', 'API Management on the Developer tier (no SLA)', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', tostring(sku.name), 'Fix', 'Use Standard v2 or Premium for production'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.apimanagement/service' and (tostring(sku.name) =~ 'Premium' and (isnull(zones) or array_length(zones) < 2)), pack('Finding', 'API Management not spread across zones', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', strcat(tostring(sku.name), ' x', tostring(sku.capacity)), 'Fix', 'Deploy the units across availability zones'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.dbforpostgresql/servers' and (true), pack('Finding', 'Azure Database for PostgreSQL single server (retired March 2025)', 'Severity', 'High', 'Detail', tostring(sku.name), 'Fix', 'Migrate to a flexible server'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.dbformysql/servers' and (true), pack('Finding', 'Azure Database for MySQL single server (retired September 2024)', 'Severity', 'High', 'Detail', tostring(sku.name), 'Fix', 'Migrate to a flexible server'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.dbformariadb/servers' and (true), pack('Finding', 'Azure Database for MariaDB (retired September 2025)', 'Severity', 'High', 'Detail', tostring(sku.name), 'Fix', 'Migrate to Azure Database for MySQL flexible server'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.dbforpostgresql/flexibleservers' and (tostring(properties.highAvailability.mode) in~ ('', 'Disabled') and tostring(sku.tier) !~ 'Burstable'), pack('Finding', 'PostgreSQL or MySQL flexible server with no high availability', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', strcat(tostring(sku.tier), ' ', tostring(sku.name)), 'Fix', 'Turn on zone-redundant high availability'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.dbformysql/flexibleservers' and (tostring(properties.highAvailability.mode) in~ ('', 'Disabled') and tostring(sku.tier) !~ 'Burstable'), pack('Finding', 'PostgreSQL or MySQL flexible server with no high availability', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', strcat(tostring(sku.tier), ' ', tostring(sku.name)), 'Fix', 'Turn on zone-redundant high availability'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.dbforpostgresql/flexibleservers' and (tostring(properties.backup.geoRedundantBackup) =~ 'Disabled'), pack('Finding', 'PostgreSQL or MySQL flexible server backups not geo-redundant', 'Severity', 'Low', 'Detail', strcat(tostring(sku.tier), ' ', tostring(sku.name)), 'Fix', 'Turn on geo-redundant backup (set when the server is created) if the data must survive a region loss'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.dbformysql/flexibleservers' and (tostring(properties.backup.geoRedundantBackup) =~ 'Disabled'), pack('Finding', 'PostgreSQL or MySQL flexible server backups not geo-redundant', 'Severity', 'Low', 'Detail', strcat(tostring(sku.tier), ' ', tostring(sku.name)), 'Fix', 'Turn on geo-redundant backup (set when the server is created) if the data must survive a region loss'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.app/managedenvironments' and (tobool(properties.zoneRedundant) != true), pack('Finding', 'Container Apps environment not zone-redundant', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', '', 'Fix', 'Create the environment with zone redundancy (it cannot be changed afterwards)'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.recoveryservices/vaults' and (tostring(properties.redundancySettings.standardTierStorageRedundancy) =~ 'LocallyRedundant'), pack('Finding', 'Recovery Services vault stores backups locally redundant', 'Severity', 'Low', 'Detail', '', 'Fix', 'Use geo-redundant storage with cross-region restore for backups that must survive a region loss'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.recoveryservices/vaults' and (tostring(properties.securitySettings.softDeleteSettings.softDeleteState) =~ 'Disabled'), pack('Finding', 'Recovery Services vault with soft delete off', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', '', 'Fix', 'Turn soft delete on (or always-on) so deleted backups can be recovered'), dynamic(null)))
| mv-expand f = Findings
| where isnotempty(tostring(f.Finding))
| project Severity = tostring(f.Severity), Finding = tostring(f.Finding), id, Detail = tostring(f.Detail),
    Fix = tostring(f.Fix), Type = type, ResourceGroup = resourceGroup, subscriptionId
| summarize Findings = count(), High = countif(Severity == 'High'), Resources = dcount(id)
| extend k = 1
| join kind=leftouter (
    advisorresources
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.advisor/recommendations'
    | extend Category = tostring(properties.category)
    | extend Pillar = case(Category =~ 'HighAvailability', 'Reliability', Category =~ 'Cost', 'Cost Optimization',
            Category =~ 'OperationalExcellence', 'Operational Excellence', Category =~ 'Performance', 'Performance Efficiency',
            Category),
        Impact = tostring(properties.impact),
        Problem = tostring(properties.shortDescription.problem),
        Solution = tostring(properties.shortDescription.solution),
        RecType = tostring(properties.recommendationTypeId),
        rid = tolower(tostring(properties.resourceMetadata.resourceId)),
        Savings = coalesce(todouble(properties.extendedProperties.annualSavingsAmount),
            12 * todouble(properties.extendedProperties.savingsAmount)),
        Currency = tostring(properties.extendedProperties.savingsCurrency)
    | join kind=leftouter (
        resources
        | where not('*' in ({Workload}))
        | where tostring(tags['{WorkloadTag}']) in ({Workload})
        | project rid = tolower(id), inWorkload = true
      ) on rid
    | where '*' in ({Workload}) or inWorkload == true
    | where Pillar == 'Reliability'
    | summarize Advisor = count(), AdvisorHigh = countif(Impact =~ 'High')
    | extend k = 1
  ) on k
| extend Advisor = coalesce(Advisor, 0), AdvisorHigh = coalesce(AdvisorHigh, 0)
| project Signal = 'Reliability', Value = Findings + Advisor,
    Detail = strcat(High + AdvisorHigh, ' high · ', Advisor, ' from Advisor'),
    State = case(High + AdvisorHigh > 0, 'Unavailable', Findings + Advisor > 0, 'Degraded', 'Available')

resources
| where type in~ ('microsoft.apimanagement/service', 'microsoft.appconfiguration/configurationstores', 'microsoft.cognitiveservices/accounts', 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines', 'microsoft.containerregistry/registries', 'microsoft.containerservice/managedclusters', 'microsoft.dbformysql/flexibleservers', 'microsoft.dbforpostgresql/flexibleservers', 'microsoft.documentdb/databaseaccounts', 'microsoft.eventgrid/domains', 'microsoft.eventgrid/topics', 'microsoft.eventhub/namespaces', 'microsoft.keyvault/vaults', 'microsoft.network/applicationgateways', 'microsoft.network/applicationgatewaywebapplicationfirewallpolicies', 'microsoft.network/frontdoorwebapplicationfirewallpolicies', 'microsoft.servicebus/namespaces', 'microsoft.signalrservice/signalr', 'microsoft.sql/servers', 'microsoft.storage/storageaccounts', 'microsoft.web/sites')
| where '*' in ({Workload}) or tostring(tags['{WorkloadTag}']) in ({Workload})
| extend Findings = pack_array(
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.storage/storageaccounts' and (tobool(properties.allowBlobPublicAccess) == true), pack('Finding', 'Storage account allows anonymous blob access', 'Severity', 'High', 'Detail', '', 'Fix', 'Set blob anonymous access to Disabled'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.storage/storageaccounts' and (tobool(properties.supportsHttpsTrafficOnly) == false), pack('Finding', 'Storage account accepts HTTP', 'Severity', 'High', 'Detail', '', 'Fix', 'Require secure transfer (HTTPS only)'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.storage/storageaccounts' and (tostring(properties.minimumTlsVersion) !in ('TLS1_2', 'TLS1_3')), pack('Finding', 'Storage account accepts TLS older than 1.2', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', tostring(properties.minimumTlsVersion), 'Fix', 'Set the minimum TLS version to 1.2'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.storage/storageaccounts' and (tostring(properties.publicNetworkAccess) !~ 'Disabled' and tostring(properties.networkAcls.defaultAction) =~ 'Allow'), pack('Finding', 'Storage account open to all networks', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', '', 'Fix', 'Use private endpoints, or set the firewall default action to Deny'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.storage/storageaccounts' and (tobool(properties.allowSharedKeyAccess) != false), pack('Finding', 'Storage account allows shared key access', 'Severity', 'Low', 'Detail', '', 'Fix', 'Authorise with Entra ID and turn off shared key access where the workload allows'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.keyvault/vaults' and (tostring(properties.publicNetworkAccess) !~ 'Disabled' and tostring(properties.networkAcls.defaultAction) !~ 'Deny'), pack('Finding', 'Key Vault open to all networks', 'Severity', 'High', 'Detail', '', 'Fix', 'Use a private endpoint, or set the firewall default action to Deny'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.keyvault/vaults' and (tobool(properties.enableRbacAuthorization) != true), pack('Finding', 'Key Vault uses access policies, not Azure RBAC', 'Severity', 'Low', 'Detail', '', 'Fix', 'Move the vault to the Azure RBAC permission model'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.sql/servers' and (tostring(properties.publicNetworkAccess) !~ 'Disabled'), pack('Finding', 'SQL server public network access enabled', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', '', 'Fix', 'Use private endpoints and turn off public network access'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.sql/servers' and (tostring(properties.minimalTlsVersion) !in ('1.2', '1.3')), pack('Finding', 'SQL server accepts TLS older than 1.2', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', tostring(properties.minimalTlsVersion), 'Fix', 'Set the minimum TLS version to 1.2'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.sql/servers' and (tobool(properties.administrators.azureADOnlyAuthentication) != true), pack('Finding', 'SQL server allows SQL authentication', 'Severity', 'Low', 'Detail', '', 'Fix', 'Turn on Microsoft Entra-only authentication'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.web/sites' and (tobool(properties.httpsOnly) != true), pack('Finding', 'App accepts HTTP', 'Severity', 'High', 'Detail', kind, 'Fix', 'Turn on HTTPS Only'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.containerservice/managedclusters' and (tobool(properties.apiServerAccessProfile.enablePrivateCluster) != true and coalesce(array_length(properties.apiServerAccessProfile.authorizedIPRanges), 0) == 0), pack('Finding', 'AKS API server open to the internet', 'Severity', 'High', 'Detail', '', 'Fix', 'Use a private cluster, or authorised IP ranges'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.containerservice/managedclusters' and (tobool(properties.disableLocalAccounts) != true), pack('Finding', 'AKS local accounts enabled', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', '', 'Fix', 'Turn off local accounts and sign in with Entra ID'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.containerregistry/registries' and (tobool(properties.anonymousPullEnabled) == true), pack('Finding', 'Container registry allows anonymous pull', 'Severity', 'High', 'Detail', tostring(sku.name), 'Fix', 'Turn off anonymous pull'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.containerregistry/registries' and (tobool(properties.adminUserEnabled) == true), pack('Finding', 'Container registry admin user enabled', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', tostring(sku.name), 'Fix', 'Turn off the admin user; pull with managed identities or scoped tokens'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines' and (isempty(tostring(properties.securityProfile.securityType))), pack('Finding', 'VM without Trusted Launch', 'Severity', 'Low', 'Detail', tostring(properties.hardwareProfile.vmSize), 'Fix', 'Use Trusted Launch (secure boot and vTPM) for new VMs; existing Generation 2 VMs can be upgraded'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.apimanagement/service' and (tostring(properties.customProperties) matches regex @'(?i)Protocols\.Tls1[01]":"true'), pack('Finding', 'API Management accepts TLS 1.0 or 1.1', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', tostring(sku.name), 'Fix', 'Turn off TLS 1.0 and 1.1 on the gateway and to the backends'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.network/applicationgateways' and (tostring(properties.sku.tier) =~ 'Standard_v2'), pack('Finding', 'Application Gateway with no web application firewall', 'Severity', 'Low', 'Detail', tostring(properties.sku.name), 'Fix', 'Use the WAF_v2 tier with a WAF policy for anything facing the internet'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.documentdb/databaseaccounts' and (tostring(properties.publicNetworkAccess) !~ 'Disabled' and tobool(properties.isVirtualNetworkFilterEnabled) != true and coalesce(array_length(properties.ipRules), 0) == 0), pack('Finding', 'Cosmos DB account open to all networks', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', '', 'Fix', 'Use private endpoints, or limit access by network'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.cognitiveservices/accounts' and (tostring(properties.publicNetworkAccess) !~ 'Disabled' and tostring(properties.networkAcls.defaultAction) !~ 'Deny'), pack('Finding', 'Azure AI services account open to all networks', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', kind, 'Fix', 'Use private endpoints, or set the network default action to Deny'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.dbforpostgresql/flexibleservers' and (tostring(properties.authConfig.passwordAuth) !~ 'Disabled'), pack('Finding', 'PostgreSQL flexible server allows password authentication', 'Severity', 'Low', 'Detail', '', 'Fix', 'Use Microsoft Entra authentication and turn off password authentication'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.dbforpostgresql/flexibleservers' and (tostring(properties.network.publicNetworkAccess) =~ 'Enabled'), pack('Finding', 'PostgreSQL or MySQL flexible server public network access enabled', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', '', 'Fix', 'Use private access (virtual network integration) or private endpoints'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.dbformysql/flexibleservers' and (tostring(properties.network.publicNetworkAccess) =~ 'Enabled'), pack('Finding', 'PostgreSQL or MySQL flexible server public network access enabled', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', '', 'Fix', 'Use private access (virtual network integration) or private endpoints'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.network/applicationgatewaywebapplicationfirewallpolicies' and (tostring(properties.policySettings.mode) =~ 'Detection' or coalesce(tostring(properties.policySettings.state), tostring(properties.policySettings.enabledState)) =~ 'Disabled'), pack('Finding', 'WAF policy in Detection mode or turned off', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', strcat(tostring(properties.policySettings.mode), ' ', coalesce(tostring(properties.policySettings.state), tostring(properties.policySettings.enabledState))), 'Fix', 'Switch the policy to Prevention mode once false positives are tuned out'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.network/frontdoorwebapplicationfirewallpolicies' and (tostring(properties.policySettings.mode) =~ 'Detection' or coalesce(tostring(properties.policySettings.state), tostring(properties.policySettings.enabledState)) =~ 'Disabled'), pack('Finding', 'WAF policy in Detection mode or turned off', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', strcat(tostring(properties.policySettings.mode), ' ', coalesce(tostring(properties.policySettings.state), tostring(properties.policySettings.enabledState))), 'Fix', 'Switch the policy to Prevention mode once false positives are tuned out'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.servicebus/namespaces' and (tostring(properties.minimumTlsVersion) in ('1.0', '1.1')), pack('Finding', 'Messaging namespace accepts TLS older than 1.2', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', tostring(properties.minimumTlsVersion), 'Fix', 'Set the minimum TLS version to 1.2'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.eventhub/namespaces' and (tostring(properties.minimumTlsVersion) in ('1.0', '1.1')), pack('Finding', 'Messaging namespace accepts TLS older than 1.2', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', tostring(properties.minimumTlsVersion), 'Fix', 'Set the minimum TLS version to 1.2'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.servicebus/namespaces' and (tobool(properties.disableLocalAuth) != true), pack('Finding', 'Key-based (local) authentication enabled', 'Severity', 'Low', 'Detail', '', 'Fix', 'Turn off local authentication and use Entra ID'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.eventhub/namespaces' and (tobool(properties.disableLocalAuth) != true), pack('Finding', 'Key-based (local) authentication enabled', 'Severity', 'Low', 'Detail', '', 'Fix', 'Turn off local authentication and use Entra ID'), dynamic(null)),

content.query:
advisorresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.advisor/advisorscore'
| extend Pillar = case(name =~ 'Advisor', 'Advisor score', name =~ 'HighAvailability', 'Reliability',
        name =~ 'Cost', 'Cost Optimization', name =~ 'OperationalExcellence', 'Operational Excellence',
        name =~ 'Performance', 'Performance Efficiency', name),
    Score = todouble(properties.lastRefreshedScore.score)
| where isnotnull(Score)
| summarize Score = round(avg(Score), 0), Subscriptions = dcount(subscriptionId) by Pillar
| project Signal = Pillar, Value = Score, Detail = strcat('average of ', Subscriptions, ' subscriptions'),
    State = case(Score >= 80, 'Available', Score >= 60, 'Degraded', 'Unavailable'),
    Order = case(Pillar == 'Advisor score', 0, Pillar == 'Reliability', 1, Pillar == 'Security', 2,
        Pillar == 'Cost Optimization', 3, Pillar == 'Operational Excellence', 4, 5)
| order by Order asc
| project-away Order

    Order = case(Pillar == 'Reliability', 1, Pillar == 'Security', 2, Pillar == 'Cost Optimization', 3, Pillar == 'Operational Excellence', 4, 5)

content.json:
**How to use this.** Pick the workload at the top (the **Workload tag** names the tag that identifies one), then
work through the pillar tabs. Each pillar tile counts the configuration checks that fail plus Azure Advisor's
recommendations for that pillar; red means at least one is high severity. *Advisor score* is Microsoft's own
0-100 score per pillar, averaged across the selected subscriptions; it is not narrowed to the workload. The checks
here are the settings a reviewer would otherwise open each resource to find. Pick a **Log Analytics workspace**
to add what only logs show (heartbeats, failed requests, refused access, resources sending no logs, ingestion, CPU
and memory). Design, process and recovery testing are not in any setting: answer them on the **Assessment** tab,
which follows the same checklist as the
[Azure Well-Architected Review](https://learn.microsoft.com/assessments/azure-architecture-review/).

content.query:
advisorresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.advisor/recommendations'
| extend Category = tostring(properties.category)
| extend Pillar = case(Category =~ 'HighAvailability', 'Reliability', Category =~ 'Cost', 'Cost Optimization',
        Category =~ 'OperationalExcellence', 'Operational Excellence', Category =~ 'Performance', 'Performance Efficiency',
        Category),
    Impact = tostring(properties.impact),
    Problem = tostring(properties.shortDescription.problem),
    Solution = tostring(properties.shortDescription.solution),
    RecType = tostring(properties.recommendationTypeId),
    rid = tolower(tostring(properties.resourceMetadata.resourceId)),
    Savings = coalesce(todouble(properties.extendedProperties.annualSavingsAmount),
        12 * todouble(properties.extendedProperties.savingsAmount)),
    Currency = tostring(properties.extendedProperties.savingsCurrency)
| join kind=leftouter (
    resources
    | where not('*' in ({Workload}))
    | where tostring(tags['{WorkloadTag}']) in ({Workload})
    | project rid = tolower(id), inWorkload = true
  ) on rid
| where '*' in ({Workload}) or inWorkload == true
| summarize High = countif(Impact =~ 'High'), Medium = countif(Impact =~ 'Medium'),
    Low = countif(Impact =~ 'Low') by Pillar
| order by Pillar asc
content.title: Azure Advisor recommendations by pillar and impact
content.noDataMessage: Advisor has no recommendations for the workload.

content.json:
### Workloads
Every workload side by side: the configuration checks that fail for each, by pillar, and its Azure Advisor recommendations. Workloads are the values of the **Workload tag**; set **Workload** to *All* to compare them all, and pick one to review it on the pillar tabs. *(untagged)* is every resource without the tag, which a review cannot assign to anyone.

    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.signalrservice/signalr' and (tobool(properties.disableLocalAuth) != true), 'SL', ''),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.eventgrid/topics' and (tobool(properties.disableLocalAuth) != true), 'SL', ''),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.eventgrid/domains' and (tobool(properties.disableLocalAuth) != true), 'SL', ''),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines' and (tostring(properties.storageProfile.osDisk.osType) =~ 'Windows' and isempty(tostring(properties.licenseType))), 'CL', ''),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.sqlvirtualmachine/sqlvirtualmachines' and (tostring(properties.sqlServerLicenseType) =~ 'PAYG'), 'CL', ''),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines' and (tostring(properties.extended.instanceView.powerState.code) =~ 'PowerState/deallocated' and tostring(properties.storageProfile.osDisk.managedDisk.storageAccountType) startswith 'Premium'), 'CL', ''),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces' and (toint(properties.retentionInDays) > 90), 'CL', ''),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces' and (tostring(properties.sku.name) in~ ('pernode', 'standalone', 'standard', 'premium')), 'CL', ''),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.network/ddosprotectionplans' and (coalesce(array_length(properties.virtualNetworks), 0) == 0), 'CM', ''),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.dbforpostgresql/flexibleservers' and (tostring(properties.state) =~ 'Stopped'), 'CL', ''),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.dbformysql/flexibleservers' and (tostring(properties.state) =~ 'Stopped'), 'CL', ''),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.compute/disks' and (tostring(properties.diskState) =~ 'Unattached' and isempty(managedBy)), 'CM', ''),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.network/publicipaddresses' and (isempty(tostring(properties.ipConfiguration.id)) and isempty(tostring(properties.natGateway.id))), 'CM', ''),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines' and (tostring(properties.extended.instanceView.powerState.code) =~ 'PowerState/stopped'), 'CM', ''),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.web/serverfarms' and (toint(properties.numberOfSites) == 0 and tolower(tostring(sku.tier)) !in ('free', 'shared', 'dynamic')), 'CM', ''),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.network/loadbalancers' and (tostring(sku.name) =~ 'Standard' and coalesce(array_length(properties.backendAddressPools), 0) == 0), 'CM', ''),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.network/natgateways' and (coalesce(array_length(properties.subnets), 0) == 0), 'CM', ''),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.compute/snapshots' and (todatetime(properties.timeCreated) < ago(90d)), 'CM', ''),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines' and (coalesce(tostring(properties.osProfile.windowsConfiguration.patchSettings.assessmentMode), tostring(properties.osProfile.linuxConfiguration.patchSettings.assessmentMode)) !~ 'AutomaticByPlatform'), 'OL', ''),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.containerservice/managedclusters' and (coalesce(tobool(properties.addonProfiles.omsagent.enabled), tobool(properties.addonProfiles.omsAgent.enabled), false) == false and tobool(properties.azureMonitorProfile.metrics.enabled) != true), 'OM', ''),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.containerservice/managedclusters' and (tostring(properties.autoUpgradeProfile.upgradeChannel) in~ ('', 'none')), 'OL', ''),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.insights/components' and (isempty(tostring(properties.WorkspaceResourceId))), 'OM', ''),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.insights/actiongroups' and (tobool(properties.enabled) == false), 'OM', ''),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.app/managedenvironments' and (isempty(tostring(properties.appLogsConfiguration.destination))), 'OL', ''),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.network/privateendpoints' and (coalesce(tostring(properties.privateLinkServiceConnections[0].properties.privateLinkServiceConnectionState.status), tostring(properties.manualPrivateLinkServiceConnections[0].properties.privateLinkServiceConnectionState.status)) !~ 'Approved'), 'OM', ''),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.insights/metricalerts' and (tobool(properties.enabled) == false), 'OL', ''),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.insights/scheduledqueryrules' and (tobool(properties.enabled) == false), 'OL', ''),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.insights/activitylogalerts' and (tobool(properties.enabled) == false), 'OL', ''),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines' and (tostring(properties.hardwareProfile.vmSize) matches regex @'(?i)^(basic_a\d+|standard_a\d+m?(_v2)?|standard_d\d+(_v2)?|standard_ds\d+(-\d+)?(_v2)?|standard_fs?\d+s?|standard_gs?\d+(-\d+)?|standard_n[cdv]\d+r?|standard_h\d+[a-z]*|standard_l\d+s)$'), 'PL', ''),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.compute/disks' and (tostring(sku.name) =~ 'Standard_LRS' and tostring(properties.diskState) in~ ('Attached', 'Reserved')), 'PL', ''),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.network/networkinterfaces' and (isnotempty(tostring(properties.virtualMachine.id)) and tobool(properties.enableAcceleratedNetworking) != true), 'PL', ''),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.storage/storageaccounts' and (kind in~ ('Storage', 'BlobStorage')), 'PL', ''),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.web/serverfarms' and (tostring(sku.tier) in~ ('Premium', 'PremiumV2')), 'PL', ''),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.containerservice/managedclusters' and (tostring(properties.agentPoolProfiles) !contains '"enableAutoScaling":true'), 'PL', ''),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.containerservice/managedclusters' and (tostring(properties.agentPoolProfiles) contains '"osDiskType":"Managed"'), 'PL', ''),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.dbforpostgresql/flexibleservers' and (tostring(sku.tier) =~ 'Burstable'), 'PL', ''),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.dbformysql/flexibleservers' and (tostring(sku.tier) =~ 'Burstable'), 'PL', ''))
    | mv-expand f = F
    | extend f = tostring(f)
    | where isnotempty(f)
    | summarize Findings = count(), High = countif(f endswith 'H'), Affected = dcount(id), Reliability = countif(f startswith 'R'), Security = countif(f startswith 'S'), Cost = countif(f startswith 'C'), Operational = countif(f startswith 'O'), Performance = countif(f startswith 'P') by Workload
  ) on Workload
| join kind=leftouter (
    advisorresources
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.advisor/recommendations'
    | extend Category = tostring(properties.category)
    | extend Pillar = case(Category =~ 'HighAvailability', 'Reliability', Category =~ 'Cost', 'Cost Optimization',
            Category =~ 'OperationalExcellence', 'Operational Excellence', Category =~ 'Performance', 'Performance Efficiency',
            Category),
        Impact = tostring(properties.impact),
        Problem = tostring(properties.shortDescription.problem),
        Solution = tostring(properties.shortDescription.solution),
        RecType = tostring(properties.recommendationTypeId),
        rid = tolower(tostring(properties.resourceMetadata.resourceId)),
        Savings = coalesce(todouble(properties.extendedProperties.annualSavingsAmount),
            12 * todouble(properties.extendedProperties.savingsAmount)),
        Currency = tostring(properties.extendedProperties.savingsCurrency)
    | join kind=inner (resources | project rid = tolower(id), Workload = tostring(tags['{WorkloadTag}'])) on rid
    | extend Workload = iff(isempty(Workload), '(untagged)', Workload)
    | summarize Advisor = count(), AdvisorHigh = countif(Impact =~ 'High') by Workload
  ) on Workload
| project Workload, TotalResources, Affected = coalesce(Affected, 0), Findings = coalesce(Findings, 0),
    High = coalesce(High, 0), Reliability = coalesce(Reliability, 0), Security = coalesce(Security, 0), Cost = coalesce(Cost, 0), Operational = coalesce(Operational, 0), Performance = coalesce(Performance, 0),
    Advisor = coalesce(Advisor, 0), AdvisorHigh = coalesce(AdvisorHigh, 0)
| order by High desc, Findings desc

content.json:
### Reliability
Can the workload survive the failure of a zone, an instance or a dependency, and recover its data? The checks look for single instances, resources not spread across availability zones, locally redundant data and SKUs Azure has retired. A resource in a region without availability zones is flagged too: record it as accepted if so.

content.query:
resources
| where type in~ ('microsoft.apimanagement/service', 'microsoft.app/managedenvironments', 'microsoft.cache/redis', 'microsoft.cdn/profiles', 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines', 'microsoft.containerservice/managedclusters', 'microsoft.dbformariadb/servers', 'microsoft.dbformysql/flexibleservers', 'microsoft.dbformysql/servers', 'microsoft.dbforpostgresql/flexibleservers', 'microsoft.dbforpostgresql/servers', 'microsoft.documentdb/databaseaccounts', 'microsoft.keyvault/vaults', 'microsoft.network/applicationgateways', 'microsoft.network/azurefirewalls', 'microsoft.network/frontdoors', 'microsoft.network/loadbalancers', 'microsoft.network/publicipaddresses', 'microsoft.network/virtualnetworkgateways', 'microsoft.recoveryservices/vaults', 'microsoft.sql/servers/databases', 'microsoft.storage/storageaccounts', 'microsoft.web/serverfarms')
| where '*' in ({Workload}) or tostring(tags['{WorkloadTag}']) in ({Workload})
| extend Findings = pack_array(
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines' and ((isnull(zones) or array_length(zones) == 0) and isempty(tostring(properties.availabilitySet.id)) and isempty(tostring(properties.virtualMachineScaleSet.id))), pack('Finding', 'VM with no availability zone, availability set or scale set', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', tostring(properties.hardwareProfile.vmSize), 'Fix', 'Run two or more instances across availability zones, or record the single point of failure as accepted'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.network/publicipaddresses' and (tostring(sku.name) =~ 'Basic'), pack('Finding', 'Basic SKU public IP (retired September 2025)', 'Severity', 'High', 'Detail', tostring(properties.ipAddress), 'Fix', 'Upgrade to a Standard SKU public IP'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.network/loadbalancers' and (tostring(sku.name) =~ 'Basic'), pack('Finding', 'Basic SKU load balancer (retired September 2025)', 'Severity', 'High', 'Detail', '', 'Fix', 'Upgrade to a Standard load balancer'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.network/applicationgateways' and (tostring(properties.sku.tier) in~ ('Standard', 'WAF')), pack('Finding', 'Application Gateway v1 (retired April 2026)', 'Severity', 'High', 'Detail', tostring(properties.sku.name), 'Fix', 'Migrate to Application Gateway v2'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.network/applicationgateways' and (tostring(properties.sku.tier) in~ ('Standard_v2', 'WAF_v2') and (isnull(zones) or array_length(zones) < 2)), pack('Finding', 'Application Gateway not spread across zones', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', tostring(properties.sku.name), 'Fix', 'Redeploy the gateway across availability zones'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.network/azurefirewalls' and ((isnull(zones) or array_length(zones) < 2)), pack('Finding', 'Azure Firewall not spread across zones', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', tostring(properties.sku.tier), 'Fix', 'Deploy the firewall across availability zones'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.network/virtualnetworkgateways' and (not(tostring(properties.sku.name) endswith 'AZ') and tostring(properties.sku.name) !~ 'ErGwScale'), pack('Finding', 'VPN or ExpressRoute gateway SKU is not zone-redundant', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', strcat(tostring(properties.gatewayType), ' ', tostring(properties.sku.name)), 'Fix', 'Move to an AZ SKU (or ErGwScale for ExpressRoute)'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.storage/storageaccounts' and (tostring(sku.name) endswith '_LRS'), pack('Finding', 'Storage account is locally redundant (LRS)', 'Severity', 'Low', 'Detail', strcat(tostring(sku.name), ' ', kind), 'Fix', 'Use ZRS, or GZRS for data that must survive the loss of a region'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.web/serverfarms' and (tolower(tostring(sku.tier)) !in ('free', 'shared', 'dynamic', 'basic', 'elasticpremium', 'flexconsumption') and toint(sku.capacity) < 2), pack('Finding', 'App Service plan runs a single instance', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', strcat(tostring(sku.name), ' x', tostring(sku.capacity)), 'Fix', 'Run at least two instances (three with zone redundancy)'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.web/serverfarms' and (tolower(tostring(sku.tier)) in ('premiumv2', 'premiumv3', 'premium0v3', 'premiummv3', 'isolatedv2') and tobool(properties.zoneRedundant) != true), pack('Finding', 'App Service plan not zone-redundant', 'Severity', 'Low', 'Detail', tostring(sku.name), 'Fix', 'Turn on zone redundancy (needs three or more instances)'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.sql/servers/databases' and (name !~ 'master' and tostring(sku.tier) !in~ ('Basic', 'Standard', 'Free', 'System') and tobool(properties.zoneRedundant) != true), pack('Finding', 'SQL database not zone-redundant', 'Severity', 'Low', 'Detail', strcat(tostring(sku.tier), ' ', tostring(sku.name)), 'Fix', 'Turn on zone redundancy'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.containerservice/managedclusters' and (tostring(properties.agentPoolProfiles) !contains '"availabilityZones":["'), pack('Finding', 'AKS node pools not spread across zones', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', tostring(properties.kubernetesVersion), 'Fix', 'Create node pools across availability zones'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.containerservice/managedclusters' and (tostring(sku.tier) =~ 'Free'), pack('Finding', 'AKS cluster on the Free tier (no uptime SLA)', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', '', 'Fix', 'Use the Standard tier for production clusters'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.keyvault/vaults' and (tobool(properties.enablePurgeProtection) != true), pack('Finding', 'Key Vault without purge protection', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', '', 'Fix', 'Turn on purge protection so a deleted key or secret can always be recovered'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.cache/redis' and (tostring(properties.sku.name) =~ 'Basic'), pack('Finding', 'Azure Cache for Redis on the Basic tier (one node, no SLA)', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', strcat(tostring(properties.sku.family), tostring(properties.sku.capacity)), 'Fix', 'Use Standard or Premium for anything beyond development'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.documentdb/databaseaccounts' and (coalesce(array_length(properties.locations), 0) < 2 and tostring(properties.locations) !contains '"isZoneRedundant":true'), pack('Finding', 'Cosmos DB account in one region with no zone redundancy', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', tostring(properties.locations[0].locationName), 'Fix', 'Turn on zone redundancy, or add a second region'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.network/frontdoors' and (true), pack('Finding', 'Front Door (classic), retiring March 2027', 'Severity', 'High', 'Detail', '', 'Fix', 'Migrate to Azure Front Door Standard or Premium'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.cdn/profiles' and (tostring(sku.name) in~ ('Standard_Verizon', 'Premium_Verizon')), pack('Finding', 'Azure CDN from Edgio (shut down January 2025)', 'Severity', 'High', 'Detail', tostring(sku.name), 'Fix', 'Move to Azure Front Door Standard or Premium'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.cdn/profiles' and (tostring(sku.name) =~ 'Standard_Microsoft'), pack('Finding', 'Azure CDN Standard from Microsoft (classic), retiring September 2027', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', tostring(sku.name), 'Fix', 'Migrate to Azure Front Door Standard or Premium'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.apimanagement/service' and (tostring(properties.platformVersion) =~ 'stv1'), pack('Finding', 'API Management on the stv1 platform (retired August 2024)', 'Severity', 'High', 'Detail', tostring(sku.name), 'Fix', 'Migrate the instance to stv2'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.apimanagement/service' and (tostring(sku.name) =~ 'Developer'), pack('Finding', 'API Management on the Developer tier (no SLA)', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', tostring(sku.name), 'Fix', 'Use Standard v2 or Premium for production'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.apimanagement/service' and (tostring(sku.name) =~ 'Premium' and (isnull(zones) or array_length(zones) < 2)), pack('Finding', 'API Management not spread across zones', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', strcat(tostring(sku.name), ' x', tostring(sku.capacity)), 'Fix', 'Deploy the units across availability zones'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.dbforpostgresql/servers' and (true), pack('Finding', 'Azure Database for PostgreSQL single server (retired March 2025)', 'Severity', 'High', 'Detail', tostring(sku.name), 'Fix', 'Migrate to a flexible server'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.dbformysql/servers' and (true), pack('Finding', 'Azure Database for MySQL single server (retired September 2024)', 'Severity', 'High', 'Detail', tostring(sku.name), 'Fix', 'Migrate to a flexible server'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.dbformariadb/servers' and (true), pack('Finding', 'Azure Database for MariaDB (retired September 2025)', 'Severity', 'High', 'Detail', tostring(sku.name), 'Fix', 'Migrate to Azure Database for MySQL flexible server'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.dbforpostgresql/flexibleservers' and (tostring(properties.highAvailability.mode) in~ ('', 'Disabled') and tostring(sku.tier) !~ 'Burstable'), pack('Finding', 'PostgreSQL or MySQL flexible server with no high availability', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', strcat(tostring(sku.tier), ' ', tostring(sku.name)), 'Fix', 'Turn on zone-redundant high availability'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.dbformysql/flexibleservers' and (tostring(properties.highAvailability.mode) in~ ('', 'Disabled') and tostring(sku.tier) !~ 'Burstable'), pack('Finding', 'PostgreSQL or MySQL flexible server with no high availability', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', strcat(tostring(sku.tier), ' ', tostring(sku.name)), 'Fix', 'Turn on zone-redundant high availability'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.dbforpostgresql/flexibleservers' and (tostring(properties.backup.geoRedundantBackup) =~ 'Disabled'), pack('Finding', 'PostgreSQL or MySQL flexible server backups not geo-redundant', 'Severity', 'Low', 'Detail', strcat(tostring(sku.tier), ' ', tostring(sku.name)), 'Fix', 'Turn on geo-redundant backup (set when the server is created) if the data must survive a region loss'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.dbformysql/flexibleservers' and (tostring(properties.backup.geoRedundantBackup) =~ 'Disabled'), pack('Finding', 'PostgreSQL or MySQL flexible server backups not geo-redundant', 'Severity', 'Low', 'Detail', strcat(tostring(sku.tier), ' ', tostring(sku.name)), 'Fix', 'Turn on geo-redundant backup (set when the server is created) if the data must survive a region loss'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.app/managedenvironments' and (tobool(properties.zoneRedundant) != true), pack('Finding', 'Container Apps environment not zone-redundant', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', '', 'Fix', 'Create the environment with zone redundancy (it cannot be changed afterwards)'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.recoveryservices/vaults' and (tostring(properties.redundancySettings.standardTierStorageRedundancy) =~ 'LocallyRedundant'), pack('Finding', 'Recovery Services vault stores backups locally redundant', 'Severity', 'Low', 'Detail', '', 'Fix', 'Use geo-redundant storage with cross-region restore for backups that must survive a region loss'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.recoveryservices/vaults' and (tostring(properties.securitySettings.softDeleteSettings.softDeleteState) =~ 'Disabled'), pack('Finding', 'Recovery Services vault with soft delete off', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', '', 'Fix', 'Turn soft delete on (or always-on) so deleted backups can be recovered'), dynamic(null)))
| mv-expand f = Findings
| where isnotempty(tostring(f.Finding))
| project Severity = tostring(f.Severity), Finding = tostring(f.Finding), id, Detail = tostring(f.Detail),
    Fix = tostring(f.Fix), Type = type, ResourceGroup = resourceGroup, subscriptionId
| summarize High = countif(Severity == 'High'), Medium = countif(Severity == 'Medium'),
    Low = countif(Severity == 'Low'), Resources = dcount(id), Checks = dcount(Finding)
| extend rows = pack_array(
    pack('Signal', 'High severity', 'Value', High, 'Detail', 'findings', 'State', iff(High > 0, 'Unavailable', 'Available')),
    pack('Signal', 'Medium severity', 'Value', Medium, 'Detail', 'findings', 'State', iff(Medium > 0, 'Degraded', 'Available')),
    pack('Signal', 'Low severity', 'Value', Low, 'Detail', 'findings', 'State', iff(Low > 0, 'Degraded', 'Available')),
    pack('Signal', 'Resources affected', 'Value', Resources, 'Detail', strcat('failing ', Checks, ' of 30 checks'),
        'State', iff(Resources > 0, 'Degraded', 'Available')))
| mv-expand r = rows
| project Signal = tostring(r.Signal), Value = toint(r.Value), Detail = tostring(r.Detail), State = tostring(r.State)

advisorresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.advisor/recommendations'
| extend Category = tostring(properties.category)
| extend Pillar = case(Category =~ 'HighAvailability', 'Reliability', Category =~ 'Cost', 'Cost Optimization',
        Category =~ 'OperationalExcellence', 'Operational Excellence', Category =~ 'Performance', 'Performance Efficiency',
        Category),
    Impact = tostring(properties.impact),
    Problem = tostring(properties.shortDescription.problem),
    Solution = tostring(properties.shortDescription.solution),
    RecType = tostring(properties.recommendationTypeId),
    rid = tolower(tostring(properties.resourceMetadata.resourceId)),
    Savings = coalesce(todouble(properties.extendedProperties.annualSavingsAmount),
        12 * todouble(properties.extendedProperties.savingsAmount)),
    Currency = tostring(properties.extendedProperties.savingsCurrency)
| join kind=leftouter (
    resources
    | where not('*' in ({Workload}))
    | where tostring(tags['{WorkloadTag}']) in ({Workload})
    | project rid = tolower(id), inWorkload = true
  ) on rid
| where '*' in ({Workload}) or inWorkload == true
| where Pillar == 'Reliability'
| summarize Recs = count(), High = countif(Impact =~ 'High'), Resources = dcount(rid)
| project Signal = 'Advisor recommendations', Value = Recs, Detail = strcat(High, ' high impact · ', Resources, ' resources'),
    State = case(High > 0, 'Unavailable', Recs > 0, 'Degraded', 'Available')

content.query:
resources
| where type in~ ('microsoft.apimanagement/service', 'microsoft.app/managedenvironments', 'microsoft.cache/redis', 'microsoft.cdn/profiles', 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines', 'microsoft.containerservice/managedclusters', 'microsoft.dbformariadb/servers', 'microsoft.dbformysql/flexibleservers', 'microsoft.dbformysql/servers', 'microsoft.dbforpostgresql/flexibleservers', 'microsoft.dbforpostgresql/servers', 'microsoft.documentdb/databaseaccounts', 'microsoft.keyvault/vaults', 'microsoft.network/applicationgateways', 'microsoft.network/azurefirewalls', 'microsoft.network/frontdoors', 'microsoft.network/loadbalancers', 'microsoft.network/publicipaddresses', 'microsoft.network/virtualnetworkgateways', 'microsoft.recoveryservices/vaults', 'microsoft.sql/servers/databases', 'microsoft.storage/storageaccounts', 'microsoft.web/serverfarms')
| where '*' in ({Workload}) or tostring(tags['{WorkloadTag}']) in ({Workload})
| extend Findings = pack_array(
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines' and ((isnull(zones) or array_length(zones) == 0) and isempty(tostring(properties.availabilitySet.id)) and isempty(tostring(properties.virtualMachineScaleSet.id))), pack('Finding', 'VM with no availability zone, availability set or scale set', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', tostring(properties.hardwareProfile.vmSize), 'Fix', 'Run two or more instances across availability zones, or record the single point of failure as accepted'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.network/publicipaddresses' and (tostring(sku.name) =~ 'Basic'), pack('Finding', 'Basic SKU public IP (retired September 2025)', 'Severity', 'High', 'Detail', tostring(properties.ipAddress), 'Fix', 'Upgrade to a Standard SKU public IP'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.network/loadbalancers' and (tostring(sku.name) =~ 'Basic'), pack('Finding', 'Basic SKU load balancer (retired September 2025)', 'Severity', 'High', 'Detail', '', 'Fix', 'Upgrade to a Standard load balancer'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.network/applicationgateways' and (tostring(properties.sku.tier) in~ ('Standard', 'WAF')), pack('Finding', 'Application Gateway v1 (retired April 2026)', 'Severity', 'High', 'Detail', tostring(properties.sku.name), 'Fix', 'Migrate to Application Gateway v2'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.network/applicationgateways' and (tostring(properties.sku.tier) in~ ('Standard_v2', 'WAF_v2') and (isnull(zones) or array_length(zones) < 2)), pack('Finding', 'Application Gateway not spread across zones', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', tostring(properties.sku.name), 'Fix', 'Redeploy the gateway across availability zones'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.network/azurefirewalls' and ((isnull(zones) or array_length(zones) < 2)), pack('Finding', 'Azure Firewall not spread across zones', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', tostring(properties.sku.tier), 'Fix', 'Deploy the firewall across availability zones'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.network/virtualnetworkgateways' and (not(tostring(properties.sku.name) endswith 'AZ') and tostring(properties.sku.name) !~ 'ErGwScale'), pack('Finding', 'VPN or ExpressRoute gateway SKU is not zone-redundant', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', strcat(tostring(properties.gatewayType), ' ', tostring(properties.sku.name)), 'Fix', 'Move to an AZ SKU (or ErGwScale for ExpressRoute)'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.storage/storageaccounts' and (tostring(sku.name) endswith '_LRS'), pack('Finding', 'Storage account is locally redundant (LRS)', 'Severity', 'Low', 'Detail', strcat(tostring(sku.name), ' ', kind), 'Fix', 'Use ZRS, or GZRS for data that must survive the loss of a region'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.web/serverfarms' and (tolower(tostring(sku.tier)) !in ('free', 'shared', 'dynamic', 'basic', 'elasticpremium', 'flexconsumption') and toint(sku.capacity) < 2), pack('Finding', 'App Service plan runs a single instance', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', strcat(tostring(sku.name), ' x', tostring(sku.capacity)), 'Fix', 'Run at least two instances (three with zone redundancy)'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.web/serverfarms' and (tolower(tostring(sku.tier)) in ('premiumv2', 'premiumv3', 'premium0v3', 'premiummv3', 'isolatedv2') and tobool(properties.zoneRedundant) != true), pack('Finding', 'App Service plan not zone-redundant', 'Severity', 'Low', 'Detail', tostring(sku.name), 'Fix', 'Turn on zone redundancy (needs three or more instances)'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.sql/servers/databases' and (name !~ 'master' and tostring(sku.tier) !in~ ('Basic', 'Standard', 'Free', 'System') and tobool(properties.zoneRedundant) != true), pack('Finding', 'SQL database not zone-redundant', 'Severity', 'Low', 'Detail', strcat(tostring(sku.tier), ' ', tostring(sku.name)), 'Fix', 'Turn on zone redundancy'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.containerservice/managedclusters' and (tostring(properties.agentPoolProfiles) !contains '"availabilityZones":["'), pack('Finding', 'AKS node pools not spread across zones', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', tostring(properties.kubernetesVersion), 'Fix', 'Create node pools across availability zones'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.containerservice/managedclusters' and (tostring(sku.tier) =~ 'Free'), pack('Finding', 'AKS cluster on the Free tier (no uptime SLA)', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', '', 'Fix', 'Use the Standard tier for production clusters'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.keyvault/vaults' and (tobool(properties.enablePurgeProtection) != true), pack('Finding', 'Key Vault without purge protection', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', '', 'Fix', 'Turn on purge protection so a deleted key or secret can always be recovered'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.cache/redis' and (tostring(properties.sku.name) =~ 'Basic'), pack('Finding', 'Azure Cache for Redis on the Basic tier (one node, no SLA)', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', strcat(tostring(properties.sku.family), tostring(properties.sku.capacity)), 'Fix', 'Use Standard or Premium for anything beyond development'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.documentdb/databaseaccounts' and (coalesce(array_length(properties.locations), 0) < 2 and tostring(properties.locations) !contains '"isZoneRedundant":true'), pack('Finding', 'Cosmos DB account in one region with no zone redundancy', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', tostring(properties.locations[0].locationName), 'Fix', 'Turn on zone redundancy, or add a second region'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.network/frontdoors' and (true), pack('Finding', 'Front Door (classic), retiring March 2027', 'Severity', 'High', 'Detail', '', 'Fix', 'Migrate to Azure Front Door Standard or Premium'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.cdn/profiles' and (tostring(sku.name) in~ ('Standard_Verizon', 'Premium_Verizon')), pack('Finding', 'Azure CDN from Edgio (shut down January 2025)', 'Severity', 'High', 'Detail', tostring(sku.name), 'Fix', 'Move to Azure Front Door Standard or Premium'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.cdn/profiles' and (tostring(sku.name) =~ 'Standard_Microsoft'), pack('Finding', 'Azure CDN Standard from Microsoft (classic), retiring September 2027', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', tostring(sku.name), 'Fix', 'Migrate to Azure Front Door Standard or Premium'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.apimanagement/service' and (tostring(properties.platformVersion) =~ 'stv1'), pack('Finding', 'API Management on the stv1 platform (retired August 2024)', 'Severity', 'High', 'Detail', tostring(sku.name), 'Fix', 'Migrate the instance to stv2'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.apimanagement/service' and (tostring(sku.name) =~ 'Developer'), pack('Finding', 'API Management on the Developer tier (no SLA)', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', tostring(sku.name), 'Fix', 'Use Standard v2 or Premium for production'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.apimanagement/service' and (tostring(sku.name) =~ 'Premium' and (isnull(zones) or array_length(zones) < 2)), pack('Finding', 'API Management not spread across zones', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', strcat(tostring(sku.name), ' x', tostring(sku.capacity)), 'Fix', 'Deploy the units across availability zones'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.dbforpostgresql/servers' and (true), pack('Finding', 'Azure Database for PostgreSQL single server (retired March 2025)', 'Severity', 'High', 'Detail', tostring(sku.name), 'Fix', 'Migrate to a flexible server'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.dbformysql/servers' and (true), pack('Finding', 'Azure Database for MySQL single server (retired September 2024)', 'Severity', 'High', 'Detail', tostring(sku.name), 'Fix', 'Migrate to a flexible server'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.dbformariadb/servers' and (true), pack('Finding', 'Azure Database for MariaDB (retired September 2025)', 'Severity', 'High', 'Detail', tostring(sku.name), 'Fix', 'Migrate to Azure Database for MySQL flexible server'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.dbforpostgresql/flexibleservers' and (tostring(properties.highAvailability.mode) in~ ('', 'Disabled') and tostring(sku.tier) !~ 'Burstable'), pack('Finding', 'PostgreSQL or MySQL flexible server with no high availability', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', strcat(tostring(sku.tier), ' ', tostring(sku.name)), 'Fix', 'Turn on zone-redundant high availability'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.dbformysql/flexibleservers' and (tostring(properties.highAvailability.mode) in~ ('', 'Disabled') and tostring(sku.tier) !~ 'Burstable'), pack('Finding', 'PostgreSQL or MySQL flexible server with no high availability', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', strcat(tostring(sku.tier), ' ', tostring(sku.name)), 'Fix', 'Turn on zone-redundant high availability'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.dbforpostgresql/flexibleservers' and (tostring(properties.backup.geoRedundantBackup) =~ 'Disabled'), pack('Finding', 'PostgreSQL or MySQL flexible server backups not geo-redundant', 'Severity', 'Low', 'Detail', strcat(tostring(sku.tier), ' ', tostring(sku.name)), 'Fix', 'Turn on geo-redundant backup (set when the server is created) if the data must survive a region loss'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.dbformysql/flexibleservers' and (tostring(properties.backup.geoRedundantBackup) =~ 'Disabled'), pack('Finding', 'PostgreSQL or MySQL flexible server backups not geo-redundant', 'Severity', 'Low', 'Detail', strcat(tostring(sku.tier), ' ', tostring(sku.name)), 'Fix', 'Turn on geo-redundant backup (set when the server is created) if the data must survive a region loss'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.app/managedenvironments' and (tobool(properties.zoneRedundant) != true), pack('Finding', 'Container Apps environment not zone-redundant', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', '', 'Fix', 'Create the environment with zone redundancy (it cannot be changed afterwards)'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.recoveryservices/vaults' and (tostring(properties.redundancySettings.standardTierStorageRedundancy) =~ 'LocallyRedundant'), pack('Finding', 'Recovery Services vault stores backups locally redundant', 'Severity', 'Low', 'Detail', '', 'Fix', 'Use geo-redundant storage with cross-region restore for backups that must survive a region loss'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.recoveryservices/vaults' and (tostring(properties.securitySettings.softDeleteSettings.softDeleteState) =~ 'Disabled'), pack('Finding', 'Recovery Services vault with soft delete off', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', '', 'Fix', 'Turn soft delete on (or always-on) so deleted backups can be recovered'), dynamic(null)))
| mv-expand f = Findings
| where isnotempty(tostring(f.Finding))
| project Severity = tostring(f.Severity), Finding = tostring(f.Finding), id, Detail = tostring(f.Detail),
    Fix = tostring(f.Fix), Type = type, ResourceGroup = resourceGroup, subscriptionId
| summarize Resources = dcount(id), Types = strcat_array(make_set(Type, 5), ', ') by Finding, Severity, Fix
| project Severity, Finding, Resources, Fix, Types
| order by case(Severity == 'High', 0, Severity == 'Medium', 1, 2) asc, Resources desc
content.title: Configuration checks that fail
content.noDataMessage: Every configuration check passes for the workload.

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines'
| where '*' in ({Workload}) or tostring(tags['{WorkloadTag}']) in ({Workload})
| project id = tolower(id),
    OS = tostring(properties.storageProfile.osDisk.osType),
    Power = tostring(properties.extended.instanceView.powerState.displayStatus),
    ResourceGroup = resourceGroup, Location = location
| join kind=leftouter (
    recoveryservicesresources
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.recoveryservices/vaults/backupfabrics/protectioncontainers/protecteditems' and tostring(properties.backupManagementType) =~ 'AzureIaasVM' or type =~ 'microsoft.recoveryservices/vaults/replicationfabrics/replicationprotectioncontainers/replicationprotecteditems'
    | extend isBackup = type =~ 'microsoft.recoveryservices/vaults/backupfabrics/protectioncontainers/protecteditems'
    | project isBackup, vmId = tolower(iff(isBackup,
            coalesce(tostring(properties.sourceResourceId), tostring(properties.virtualMachineId)),
            coalesce(tostring(properties.providerSpecificDetails.fabricObjectId),
                tostring(properties.providerSpecificDetails.protectedManagedDisks[0].sourceManagedDiskId)))),
        vault = iff(isBackup, tostring(split(id, '/')[8]), ''),
        lastBackup = iff(isBackup, todatetime(properties.lastBackupTime), datetime(null))
    | where isBackup and isnotempty(vmId) or vmId has '/virtualmachines/'
    | summarize Vault = max(vault), LastBackup = max(lastBackup), Replicated = countif(not(isBackup)) by id = vmId
  ) on id
| project id, Protection = iff(isempty(Vault), 'Not protected', 'Protected'), Vault, LastBackup,
    Replication = iff(Replicated > 0, 'Replicated', ''), OS, Power, ResourceGroup, Location
| where Protection == 'Not protected' and isempty(Replication)
| project id, OS, Power, ResourceGroup, Location
| order by ResourceGroup asc

content.noDataMessage: Every VM is backed up or replicated.

content.query:
healthresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.resourcehealth/availabilitystatuses'
| extend State = tostring(properties.availabilityState)

content.json: Recovery is the part of reliability settings show least: the **Backup & Recovery** workbook has failed jobs, stale backups and test failovers. Record a recovery time and recovery point target for the workload, and test a restore against them.
Pick a **Log Analytics workspace** at the top to add the checks only logs can answer on this tab. They read the workspace the workload sends its logs to; pick several if its logs are split.

content.query:
let Start = todatetime('{TimeRange:startISO}');
let End = min_of(now(), todatetime('{TimeRange:endISO}'));
let Beats = Heartbeat
    | where isnotempty(_ResourceId)
    | extend rid = strcat_array(array_slice(split(tolower(_ResourceId), '/'), 0, 8), '/')
    | where '*' in ({Workload}) or set_has_element(dynamic([{WorkloadIds}]), rid)
    | summarize by rid, Computer, Hour = bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
    | summarize Hours = count(), First = min(Hour), LastSeen = max(Hour) by rid, Computer;
let Machines = print rid = dynamic([{WorkloadIds}])
    | mv-expand rid to typeof(string)
    | where isnotempty(rid)
    | where (rid contains '/microsoft.compute/virtualmachines/' or rid contains '/microsoft.hybridcompute/machines/');
Machines
| join kind=fullouter Beats on rid
| extend id = coalesce(rid1, rid), Hours = coalesce(Hours, 0)
| extend Expected = max_of(1, datetime_diff('hour', End, max_of(Start, coalesce(First, Start))))
| project id, Computer, Availability = round(min_of(100.0, 100.0 * Hours / Expected), 1), Hours, Expected, LastSeen
| order by Availability asc

content.query:
AppRequests
| extend rid = strcat_array(array_slice(split(tolower(_ResourceId), '/'), 0, 8), '/')
| where '*' in ({Workload}) or set_has_element(dynamic([{WorkloadIds}]), rid)
| summarize Requests = sum(ItemCount), Failed = sumif(ItemCount, Success == false),
    P95 = percentile(DurationMs, 95) by id = rid, App = AppRoleName
| project id, App, Requests, Failed, FailedPct = round(100.0 * Failed / Requests, 2), P95Ms = round(P95)

content.query:
union isfuzzy=true
    (datatable(TimeGenerated: datetime, _ResourceId: string, Status: int, Caller: string, Operation: string)[]),
    (AZKVAuditLogs
    | where HttpStatusCode == 403
    | project TimeGenerated, _ResourceId, Status = toint(HttpStatusCode), Caller = CallerIpAddress, Operation = OperationName),
    (AzureDiagnostics
    | where ResourceProvider == 'MICROSOFT.KEYVAULT'
    | where toint(column_ifexists('httpStatusCode_d', real(null))) == 403
    | project TimeGenerated, _ResourceId, Status = 403, Caller = tostring(column_ifexists('CallerIPAddress', '')),
        Operation = OperationName),
    (StorageBlobLogs
    | where StatusCode == 403
    | project TimeGenerated, _ResourceId, Status = toint(StatusCode), Caller = tostring(split(CallerIpAddress, ':')[0]),
        Operation = OperationName)
| extend rid = strcat_array(array_slice(split(tolower(_ResourceId), '/'), 0, 8), '/')
| where '*' in ({Workload}) or set_has_element(dynamic([{WorkloadIds}]), rid)
| summarize Denied = count(), Callers = dcount(Caller), Last = max(TimeGenerated) by id = rid, Operation
| order by Denied desc
| take 200

content.json:
### Cost Optimization
Is the workload paying for anything it does not use? The checks look for idle resources, licences paid in the VM price and data kept longer than needed. Advisor's right-sizing, reservation and savings plan recommendations carry its estimated savings a year. Resource Graph holds no spend: use Cost Management for what the workload costs.

content.query:
resources

    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.sqlvirtualmachine/sqlvirtualmachines' and (tostring(properties.sqlServerLicenseType) =~ 'PAYG'), pack('Finding', 'SQL Server VM paying for its SQL licence', 'Severity', 'Low', 'Detail', tostring(properties.sqlImageSku), 'Fix', 'With SQL Server licences under Software Assurance, set the licence type to AHUB'), dynamic(null)),

content.json: Savings are Azure Advisor's own estimate for a year. The **Cloud Center of Excellence** workbook's *Cost* tab rolls the same savings and idle resources up by subscription.
Pick a **Log Analytics workspace** at the top to add the checks only logs can answer on this tab. They read the workspace the workload sends its logs to; pick several if its logs are split.

content.query:
let ByTable = union withsource=WafSourceTable_ *
    | where _IsBillable == true and isnotempty(_ResourceId)
    | extend rid = strcat_array(array_slice(split(tolower(_ResourceId), '/'), 0, 8), '/')
    | where '*' in ({Workload}) or set_has_element(dynamic([{WorkloadIds}]), rid)
    | summarize GB = sum(_BilledSize) / 1e9 by rid, Table = WafSourceTable_;
ByTable
| summarize TotalGB = round(sum(GB), 2), Tables = count() by rid
| join kind=inner (ByTable | summarize arg_max(GB, Table) by rid) on rid
| project id = rid, TotalGB, LargestTable = Table, LargestGB = round(GB, 2), Tables
| order by TotalGB desc
| take 200

content.json:
### Operational Excellence
Is the workload observable and maintained? The checks look for machines without the Azure Monitor Agent, patching that is not assessed, AKS clusters with no monitoring or upgrades, retired Application Insights, disabled alerting, and changes made by hand in the portal rather than through a pipeline.

content.query:
resources
| where type in~ ('microsoft.app/managedenvironments', 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines', 'microsoft.containerservice/managedclusters', 'microsoft.insights/actiongroups', 'microsoft.insights/activitylogalerts', 'microsoft.insights/components', 'microsoft.insights/metricalerts', 'microsoft.insights/scheduledqueryrules', 'microsoft.network/privateendpoints')
| where '*' in ({Workload}) or tostring(tags['{WorkloadTag}']) in ({Workload})
| extend Findings = pack_array(
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines' and (coalesce(tostring(properties.osProfile.windowsConfiguration.patchSettings.assessmentMode), tostring(properties.osProfile.linuxConfiguration.patchSettings.assessmentMode)) !~ 'AutomaticByPlatform'), pack('Finding', 'Periodic patch assessment off', 'Severity', 'Low', 'Detail', '', 'Fix', 'Turn on periodic assessment in Azure Update Manager (or assign the built-in policy)'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.containerservice/managedclusters' and (coalesce(tobool(properties.addonProfiles.omsagent.enabled), tobool(properties.addonProfiles.omsAgent.enabled), false) == false and tobool(properties.azureMonitorProfile.metrics.enabled) != true), pack('Finding', 'AKS cluster with no Container insights or managed Prometheus', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', '', 'Fix', 'Turn on Container insights and managed Prometheus'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.containerservice/managedclusters' and (tostring(properties.autoUpgradeProfile.upgradeChannel) in~ ('', 'none')), pack('Finding', 'AKS automatic upgrades off', 'Severity', 'Low', 'Detail', tostring(properties.kubernetesVersion), 'Fix', 'Set an auto-upgrade channel (patch or stable) with a planned maintenance window'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.insights/components' and (isempty(tostring(properties.WorkspaceResourceId))), pack('Finding', 'Classic Application Insights (retired February 2024)', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', '', 'Fix', 'Migrate to a workspace-based Application Insights resource'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.insights/actiongroups' and (tobool(properties.enabled) == false), pack('Finding', 'Action group disabled', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', '', 'Fix', 'Turn it back on, or delete it and the alert rules that use it'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.app/managedenvironments' and (isempty(tostring(properties.appLogsConfiguration.destination))), pack('Finding', 'Container Apps environment sends its logs nowhere', 'Severity', 'Low', 'Detail', '', 'Fix', 'Send the logs to Log Analytics or to Azure Monitor'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.network/privateendpoints' and (coalesce(tostring(properties.privateLinkServiceConnections[0].properties.privateLinkServiceConnectionState.status), tostring(properties.manualPrivateLinkServiceConnections[0].properties.privateLinkServiceConnectionState.status)) !~ 'Approved'), pack('Finding', 'Private endpoint connection not approved', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', coalesce(tostring(properties.privateLinkServiceConnections[0].properties.privateLinkServiceConnectionState.status), tostring(properties.manualPrivateLinkServiceConnections[0].properties.privateLinkServiceConnectionState.status)), 'Fix', 'Approve the connection on the target resource, or delete the endpoint'), dynamic(null)),

content.json:
### Performance Efficiency
Can the workload scale and does it use current hardware? The checks look for older VM sizes, Standard HDD disks, accelerated networking turned off, legacy storage and App Service tiers, and compute with no autoscale.

content.query:
resources
| where type in~ ('microsoft.compute/disks', 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines', 'microsoft.containerservice/managedclusters', 'microsoft.dbformysql/flexibleservers', 'microsoft.dbforpostgresql/flexibleservers', 'microsoft.network/networkinterfaces', 'microsoft.storage/storageaccounts', 'microsoft.web/serverfarms')
| where '*' in ({Workload}) or tostring(tags['{WorkloadTag}']) in ({Workload})
| extend Findings = pack_array(
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines' and (tostring(properties.hardwareProfile.vmSize) matches regex @'(?i)^(basic_a\d+|standard_a\d+m?(_v2)?|standard_d\d+(_v2)?|standard_ds\d+(-\d+)?(_v2)?|standard_fs?\d+s?|standard_gs?\d+(-\d+)?|standard_n[cdv]\d+r?|standard_h\d+[a-z]*|standard_l\d+s)$'), pack('Finding', 'Older-generation VM size', 'Severity', 'Low', 'Detail', tostring(properties.hardwareProfile.vmSize), 'Fix', 'Resize to a current generation for better price-performance'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.compute/disks' and (tostring(sku.name) =~ 'Standard_LRS' and tostring(properties.diskState) in~ ('Attached', 'Reserved')), pack('Finding', 'Disk on Standard HDD', 'Severity', 'Low', 'Detail', strcat(tostring(properties.diskSizeGB), ' GB'), 'Fix', 'Use Standard SSD or Premium SSD for anything sensitive to latency'), dynamic(null)),
